mods.name: Digimon World Next Order
mods.changelog: TikFinity webhook with the gift sender's name in every popup; gift spam is queued, nothing is lost.
mods.after_install: Start the game once: the first start with BepInEx takes 1-3 minutes (black screen). That is normal.
howto: Click Start in the launcher (it opens DWNOGift.exe and the game). Keep the black DWNOGift window open while you stream.

Triggers tab: add TikTok gifts, follows, shares, likes or chat commands and pick the effect each one triggers. Then click the TikTok button at the top, type your username and Connect after you go LIVE. The launcher must stay open (it keeps running in the background while you are live).
The first game start with BepInEx takes 1-3 minutes on a black screen. That is normal.
Or use TikFinity key presses: hotkeys live in BepInEx\config\DWNO_GiftMod.txt in the game folder.
Never put the same gift on a webhook AND a key press, or it fires twice.
Windows Smart App Control or an antivirus may block BepInEx or the .exe files (they are not code-signed). Allow them.
effects: give an item by name, any amount
right partner digivolves now (evolve:1 = left, evolve = both)
partner falls asleep right away (time jumps)
a wild Digimon from this area attacks (summon:boss = boss version)
the Tamer floats up and drops back down
partner loses one game day of lifespan
teleport to the Floatia town square (warp:random = random known area)
gacha: one of them at random

mods.name: Coral Island
mods.changelog: First release: 30+ effects, gift sender's name in every popup, TikFinity webhook.
howto: Click Start in the launcher (it opens CoralGift.exe and the game). Keep the black CoralGift window open while you stream.

Triggers tab: add TikTok gifts, follows, shares, likes or chat commands and pick the effect each one triggers. Then click the TikTok button at the top, type your username and Connect after you go LIVE. The launcher must stay open (it keeps running in the background while you are live).
Or use TikFinity key presses: hotkeys live in CoralGift.txt next to CoralGift.exe (created on the first start).
Never put the same gift on a webhook AND a key press, or it fires twice.
The 'faint' effect ends the in-game day (the game saves and takes a gold penalty). Use it only if you want that.
effects: a random item (item:Grilled fish:3 for a specific one)
frozen in an ice block for 10 s
struck by lightning: shocked, charred black, -energy
spins like a top, dizzy afterwards
tiny + turbo + reversed controls at once
the player is renamed to the gift sender
change the weather (sunny, rain, storm, snow...)
gacha: one of them at random
